lines: Commits: e198f4b fix(admin-copy): drop backend jargon and raw codes from admin screens; 816adb1 fix(admin-copy): say publish replaces the config; soften freshness copy (review fixes, separate commit, no amend). Base f50bc56. Frontend display only.

WHAT: copy without backend/server/row/folded/read-live wording on Overview (+Today), Records, client hub Portfolio summary, Returns, Client values hub, One investor, Collective preview, Monthly value preview and out-of-date notice, investor record (Positions, Ledger entries), Users, Audit, App config.

App config (U12): 'API origin' -> 'API address', value = resolveApiBase() from lib/env (same resolver http.ts uses); 'Not configured in this build' only on ConfigurationError. 816adb1: hint now 'JSON. This replaces the whole configuration. A key you leave out is cleared, and maintenance is off unless you turn it on.' (publish stores the JSON verbatim as a new version; no merge, no backend defaults). Publish dialog has no merge/default claim, unchanged.

Freshness (816adb1): Overview, Today, Portfolio summary, Returns, Records say 'up to date when you open' (queries use STALE.MONEY 15 s), replacing 'counted fresh each time' / 'shows the latest records'.

Raw values: roleLabel map in domain/permissions.ts (user page Roles, Overview Your access, Account still Superadmin/Admin). Template names via features/admin/emails/emailTemplateLabels.ts (Emails, client Emails tab, application detail). Maturity and payout state maps beside MaturityPanel / WithdrawalPayoutPanel, with a raw-value fallback since 816adb1 (satisfies still forces a label for every contract value). Application decision -> applicationState badge.

Version rows removed (user and application detail): users.version / applications.version are optimistic-lock counters bumped by email/phone/contact/lifecycle writes; not a credential or email revision. No write or test reads the displayed row.
COMPAT (rule 11): no request, response, schema, route or permission change. Released APKs and the rollback target unaffected.
TESTS: none added (copy, rule 10); heldMoneyWrites.test.tsx:500 now expects /· Paid$/. No red control: no new guard.

CHECKS on 816adb1 (head, clean tree): npm ci && npm run check 20261118T064342Z-3130418 (58 files, 511 tests); build:android 20261118T064457Z-3168405 (client 72 assets, 982296 bytes); build:android:admin 20261118T064506Z-3172754 (admin 105 assets, 1351316 bytes).

WHAT: copy without backend/server/row/folded/read-live wording on Overview (+Today), Records, client hub Portfolio summary, Returns, Client values hub, One investor, Collective preview, Monthly value preview and out-of-date notice, investor record (Positions, Ledger entries), Users, Audit, App config.

App config (U12): 'API origin' -> 'API address', value = resolveApiBase() from lib/env (same resolver src/api uses: injected __BOE_API_BASE__, then VITE_BEO_API_BASE_URL, then origin+/api); 'Not configured in this build' only if it throws ConfigurationError. Config source, JSON hint, validation message, publish dialog reworded.

Raw values: roleLabel map in domain/permissions.ts used by user page Roles, Overview 'Your access', Account (still Superadmin/Admin). Template keys -> names via new features/admin/emails/emailTemplateLabels.ts (deliveries filter list moved there; used by Emails, client Emails tab, application detail). Maturity history Status and payout card state -> label maps beside MaturityPanel / WithdrawalPayoutPanel. Application decision -> applicationState badge.

Version rows removed (user detail, application detail): users.version / applications.version are optimistic-lock counters bumped by email/phone/contact/lifecycle writes (userRepository, userContactRepository, adminOversightRepository.setUserAccountState); not a credential or email revision, nothing an admin can use. Writes do not read the displayed row.
COMPAT (rule 11): no request, response, schema, route or permission change; reads existing fields only. Released APKs and the rollback target unaffected.
TESTS: no new tests (copy, rule 10). Updated heldMoneyWrites.test.tsx:500 /· paid$/ -> /· Paid$/ for the payout label. No red control: no new guard.
